messages:
Priya: Heads-up — Mistral-7B-v2 weights uploaded to gs://redwood-models/mistral/mistral-7b-v2/ and tokenizer.json is next to the weights. Can someone do a quick tokenizer + chat-template sanity check before we flip the serving config?
Mike: On it. Quick Q: which chat template are we validating against? the new two-turn assistant template or the old single-turn?
Priya: Two-turn (user -> assistant -> followup). Example prompt: `User: {user}
Assistant:` we append system prefix earlier. Noticed some truncations when we batch with add_bos=False.
Anna: Repro'd a related issue yesterday — when special tokens include `` and we run concat of segments the final EOS gets dropped in the runtime path, causing KV-cache length mismatch on 2nd turn. Short repro: `tokenizer.encode('Hi' + '' + 'Assistant:')` yields missing terminal token.
Mike: Hmm. I think the tokenizer config we bundled has `add_special_tokens=True` but `add_bos=False` for chat calls. Two quick fixes: set `add_bos=True` for chat templates OR explicitly include BOS in the template. Also ensure `pad_token` exists (suggest `<|pad|>`).
Anna: Agreed. Also noticed the tokenizer strips zero-width spaces in system prefix which shifts tokenization boundary for short inputs. Might be separate but affects few test prompts.
Priya: Action items: 1) Mike — run tokenizer test sweep against sample prompts in models/mistral/validation/prompts/ and add unit test for EOS-preservation. 2) Anna — check if zero-width-space normalization is enabled in tokenizer.json and toggle off if present. 3) Whoever patches, update the weights manifest to include `tokenizer.json` path and ping me.
Mike: I'll add a test in `tokenizer/tests/test_chat_template.py` and push a tiny fix that sets `add_bos=True` in ChatTokenizer.encode when format=="chat". Will also add a CI case for batching.
tokenizer-bot: AUTO-CHECK: tokenizer.json parsed; special_tokens present: ["", "<|pad|>"]; normalization: unicode_nfd=False, strip_whitespace=True.
Anna: If strip_whitespace=True that's probably the culprit for the zero-width issue — I'll try toggling `strip_whitespace=False` and re-run the sample set.
Priya: Great. Once tests pass, we'll update the serving config to pin `tokenizer_version: v2` and flip `use_eos_in_cache: true` for this model. Please @me on the PR and include sample encoded token lengths for a 2-turn convo. :+1:
Mike: Will do. ETA for PR: EOD today.
Priya: Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.
Mike: np — pinging when green. :rocket:
